decisions.reason: The margin analysis was launched only in 2023, its prospects are still uncertain, and it reuses the firm's maintained market data, so keeping the option open costs little.
The gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer, has its own page and needs little extra cost to maintain on the shared databases, so the option is worth holding.
The electricity tariff calculator is a low-cost extension of the established tariff database, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not materialize.
This multi-model line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with Product C, which raises the chance it gets consolidated, but it is too early to judge, so it stays for now.
The area definition tool supports the other location-based products on the central platform, so keeping it costs little and it adds value to related options.
The site-specific comparison line is only mentioned on the website and partly overlaps with Product B, but its uncertainty is not yet resolved and its upkeep is cheap, so the option stays open.
